children: William D. Mosley, a director and the CEO, reported direct sales of ordinary shares in two transactions on September 10, 2026 executed at $862.1337 and $862.1351 per share for a weighted average price of $862.1344 per share and total proceeds of $2,455,358; the reporter directly owns 296,449 ordinary shares following the transactions.

Romano Gianluca, an officer serving as EVP & CFO, reported two direct sale transactions on September 10, 2026 that sold a total of 1,347 ordinary shares for aggregate proceeds of $1,161,293 at a weighted average price of approximately $862.13 per share; following the reported transactions Romano Gianluca directly beneficially owned 28,930 ordinary shares and the filing notes the shares include RSU grants awarded under the Seagate Technology Holdings plc 2022 Equity Incentive Plan with specified vesting schedules.
